rule: No W1 capability disappears silently. Each one is kept, has a successor that must be measured against it before it is retired, is temporarily absent with its successor and gate named, or is removed on purpose with the reason. The viewer shows this ledger; a gate's status is read from its evidence file.

entries.w1: Vision organ: tile decoder from pixels
entries.cb2: The same organ; the predictive core also sees the raw frame

entries.w1: Episodic memory: remembered world map, objects, last-seen log
entries.cb2: Kept as its memory organ (P-A reads it). Successor: memory held in the core's own state
entries.gate: Retire the map only when the core recovers remembered out-of-view places (probe) and P-B comes within 2 points of P-A's agreement

entries.w1: Commitments ledger from the caretaker's requests (template parser)
entries.cb2: Kept. Successor: an open-weight language organ (Qwen) through the organ interface
entries.gate: Parse and keep requests at least as well as the template parser on held-out caretaker messages

entries.w1: Self-model: its success per kind of request, its vitals
Speech: answers from its own memory, acknowledgements
entries.cb2: Kept; later spoken by the language organ

entries.w1: Autobiography: its diary and its record of lives
entries.cb2: Kept. Only LIVED x SELF moments can enter it; dreams and practice never do

entries.w1: Across its lives: continuity and learning history
entries.cb2: Kept, and every lived moment is now in a hash-chained archive
Learned skill policy acting from the predictive core (imitation first, then its own improvement)
entries.gate: Held-out agreement >= 0.90; on 40 fresh worlds, score and survival each >= 0.8 x the routine's. Retired only when the learned skill outlives the routine

entries.w1: Foresight: 5 risks within 100 steps, from 62 belief features
entries.cb2: The predictive core's risk head: the same 5 risks at 25, 100 and 300 steps, from what it sees and remembers
entries.gate: Gate 1: on held-out lived lives, the core's 100-step risk predictions are at least as good (Brier) as the old foresight network trained on the same data, for every risk

entries.w1: Choosing between options: learned values, confidence that another choice is better
entries.cb2: Imagined alternatives from the core (shown now, from the first trained core), then a learned value over them that it acts on
entries.gate: Gate 2: its imagined-value machinery changes what it does (turning it off changes its choices and outcomes on fresh worlds) and it does better than choosing by the routine alone

entries.w1: Learning during each life from its own returns
entries.cb2: Learning in sleep from its archive, installed by consolidation
entries.gate: Each consolidation is measured against the skill it replaces on fresh worlds; a worse one is rolled back

entries.cb2: Bounded drives (needs, curiosity as learning progress, competence, social cooperation)

entries.w1: Viewer: erase a faculty, bookmark and go back, for any individual
entries.cb2: Refused for the canonical individual; still available on copies
entries.reason: Its life is its recorded chronology: rewinding or editing it would make the record false

entries.w1: The overnight individual (1,104 lives, learned foresight and choice)
entries.cb2: Preserved and still runnable in the viewer; the reference CB2 must beat
